name: Bloodstride Blade
text:
This +2 greater striking cunning wounding sawtooth saber appears rusty but never loses its edge. It's drawn to the blood of your targets. You gain a +2 item bonus to seek or track creatures that have blood.

Activate—Call of the Bloodthirst r

Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature within 60 feet takes bleed damage

---
Effect You cast translocate, appearing adjacent to the triggering creature, then Strike it with this weapon. The creature is Off-Guard to the attack.
